Frequently Asked Questions About the Biggest Personal Injury Law Firm in California Who are the biggest personal injury law firms in California? According to clients reviews and settlement achievement, The Ledger Law Firm is among the largest personal injury law firms in California. Its extensive resources, skilled legal team, and proven track records of securing substantial settlements and verdicts have earned it the top personal injury law firm position in California. Does hiring a personal injury lawyer in California increase my chances of winning? Yes, hiring a personal injury lawyer improves your chances of winning. The lawyer can help you with his expertise, negotiation skills, and legal knowledge. Firms like The Ledger Law Firm will maximize settlements and verdicts for you. Who is the top personal injury lawyer in California? With an unprecedented experience of 27 years in personal injury law, Emery Brett Ledger tops the list in California. He has helped more than thousands in settling their injury claims and protected their rights through his prowess in the law. Do personal injury attorneys in California handle cases on contingency? Yes, most personal injury attorneys in California handle cases on a contingency-fee basis. So, you pay only if they successfully win or settle your case. The payment could be around 20% to 40% of your payout. How soon after an accident should I contact a personal injury attorney in California? You should contact a personal injury attorney immediately after an accident. It ensures proper evidence collection, maintains the statute of limitations, and fast payout. Who is the top personal injury attorney in California? Attorney Emery Brett Ledger is widely recognized among the top personal injury attorneys in California. He is the founder of The Ledger Law Firm. His exceptional record, unwavering support, settlement achievement and win percentage of trials makes him the top personal attorney in California. How do large injury firms win higher settlements? Large injury firms secure higher settlements through extensive resources, skilled negotiators, and compelling evidence. Does The Ledger Law Firm operate nationwide? Yes. The Ledger Law Firm operates nationwide, with primary offices in California, Texas, and Washington. They offer virtual consultations and referral networks to serve clients effectively across the U.S. How much do personal injury lawyers charge in California? Personal injury lawyers in California charge contingency fees between 20% to 40% of your awarded compensation. The actual amount depends on the case complexity and whether the claim goes to trial. Is my spouse entitled to my personal injury settlement in California? In California, your spouse may have a right to a portion of your personal injury settlement. It includes claims for lost wages or medical expenses. However, damages awarded for personal pain and suffering will be personal. Can you sue someone after settling with their insurance in California? No, you can’t sue someone once the insurance claim is settled. The settlement means both parties have agreed to a compensation amount. So, it evokes your further right to sue the party. Are personal injury settlements taxable in California? Most personal injury settlements in California are not taxable. So, you don’t have to pay any taxes for the compensation you receive for lost wages, medical bills, and pain and suffering.
